selection_rule: For each source FASTA, retain the first 2000 FASTA records in file order.
manifest_construction_command:
work_dir=/path/to/private/baseline-work; data_root=/path/to/private/Sharks/megahit; mkdir -p "$work_dir/subset"; awk 'BEGIN { records = 0 } /^>/ { if (records == 2000) exit; records++ } { print }' "$data_root/BundegiBeachWater_001_20240510/final.contigs.fa" > "$work_dir/subset/BundegiBeachWater_001_20240510.fasta"; awk 'BEGIN { records = 0 } /^>/ { if (records == 2000) exit; records++ } { print }' "$data_root/BundegiBeachWater_002_20240510/final.contigs.fa" > "$work_dir/subset/BundegiBeachWater_002_20240510.fasta"; printf 'sample	contigs
BundegiBeachWater_001_20240510	subset/BundegiBeachWater_001_20240510.fasta
BundegiBeachWater_002_20240510	subset/BundegiBeachWater_002_20240510.fasta
' > "$work_dir/samples.tsv"
corrected_metric_post_processing: The baseline execution used c731c15d. reverse_complement_duplicates_collapsed and reverse_oriented_catalogue_members were recalculated with the corrected member-versus-representative orientation logic introduced by 540b71d; output sequence checksums are unchanged.

decision_preservation.reason: The tightened settings reduce candidate work on this subset but fail the checked-in Pseudomonas decision-preservation gate around the identity_9799 regression and must not be adopted.
